notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
- Added music to the credits
- Fixed an issue where the opening the options menu while in the credits would crash the game
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't unlock the "Go Outside Now," "Finishing Fast, Are We?" "Overachiever," and "Stop Cheating" achievements.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
We've updated the game to patch some bugs that have showed up on the first day of release!
- Fixed a bug where a hitbox in Sylvano Mountain Base was too short, allowing players to clip through a wall.
- Fixed a bug where after completion of the game, starting from Lurielle Village, backing out, and then going to Sacred Summit would cause the timer to start from 0:00 on the level.
- Fixed a bug where the credits cutscene would play audio at max volume, even if volume was turned down.
- Added a Final Time counter to the credits, so you can easily share your best time!

Stay tuned, we're working on a leaderboard system for the best times throughout the game!
